title: GAME TRIAD — Three Dimensions Rotating Into One

layer_0_ground.name: KENSHI — The World
layer_0_ground.what_it_gives: Characters, terrain, combat, factions, survival, STORY
layer_0_ground.what_it_needs: Logic connections (from board), physics refinement (from outer)

layer_1_board.name: SATISFACTORY × FACTORIO — The Logic (The Oblique)
layer_1_board.concept: Collapse 3D factory (Satisfactory) and 2D belt-logic (Factorio) into a 1D programming surface

satisfactory.what_it_gives: 3D factory chains, conveyor logic, resource flow, automation graphs

factorio.status: NOT INSTALLED — demo available (free, v2.1.23) but demo has NO modding
factorio.what_it_gives: 2D belt logic, inserter timing, circuit networks, blueprint strings

the_oblique.how: Satisfactory's 3D production chains + Factorio's 2D circuit logic = 1D interface board
the_oblique.the_board_programs_kenshi: Factory logic compiles into Kenshi behavior

layer_2_outer.name: SPACE ENGINEERS × KSP — The Physics (The Outer)

space_engineers.mod_api: C# — Programmable Block scripts + full mods
space_engineers.what_it_gives: Voxel building, physics simulation, programmable computers, orbital grid

ksp.what_it_gives: Orbital mechanics, gravity, atmosphere, particle trajectories, n-body physics

the_outer.how: Every bullet, dust mote, fog particle = real simulated body
the_outer.granularization: Game refines as you play — crude blobs → individual atoms
the_outer.bolt_from_gun: = tracked particle with mass, velocity, drag, gravity
the_outer.dust_in_air: = cloud of particles with Brownian motion
the_outer.refinement_loop: More play → more detail → more physics → more real

rotation.concept: The three games ROTATE. Each feeds the next.
cycle: GROUND (Kenshi): Events happen — combat, trade, faction shift
BOARD (SatFactory): Events become LOGIC — factory processes them, builds connections
OUTER (SpaceKerbal): Logic becomes PHYSICS — particles simulate, orbits compute
Back to GROUND: Physics refines the WORLD — Kenshi gets more real
rotation.fractal: Every rotation = one evolution. The game improves itself.

nerve_architecture.shared_bus: All three games write to ONE event bus

satisfactory_nerve.approach: satisfactory_eyes.py reads .sav files + SML mod hooks events

outer_nerve.approach: Programmable Block C# script + external bridge

nerve_architecture.tissue_pipeline: All three → ollama tissue models → evolve → feed back

installation_status.factorio: ❌ NOT INSTALLED — need full game (demo has no modding)
